name: Catalog demo
description: A reference for the kind of plugin library that belongs to a person: connecting an account is what creates it, and disconnecting removes it. It also searches its own service and draws a page for a title you do not have yet, so the four families that make up a searchable, streamable catalog are all here in one package. Used by the test harness.
author: Multipass

settings.label: Where the files are
settings.help: The address the titles are served from, ending in a slash. A real plugin gets this from its service; this one is told, so a test can point it at its own fixture.

settings.label: Polls before connecting succeeds
settings.help: How many times Connect has to ask before the account links. Set it above one to watch the waiting state. No real plugin has anything like this.
